extractionNotes: EXTRACTION IN PROGRESS as of Year One completion (Strands 1-3, SHS 1). Document structure confirmed: 3 fixed Strands (1. The Earth and its Neighbourhoods; 2. Navigating our Environment; 3. Human and Environment) repeated once per Year, each with a fixed Sub-Strand set (Strand 1: The Earth and its Features / Rocks, Weathering, Soil and Mass Wasting / The Earth Atmosphere; Strand 2: Maps, Their Elements and Analyses / Geospatial Data Collection, Representation and Interpretation; Strand 3: Physical Settings and People / Economic Activities / Environmental Degradation / Environmental Hazards and their Management). Scope and Sequence table (PDF page 24, printed 'GEOGRAPHY | 22') confirms overall totals of 33 Content Standards / 33 Learning Outcomes / 79 Learning Indicators (SHS1-3), matching the prior inventory pass; the per-Strand/per-Sub-Strand/per-Year breakdown numbers in that same table are garbled by column-collision in the -layout text extraction (digits run together, e.g. '44 8', '224', '112' with no reliable column boundaries) and could not be reliably parsed cell-by-cell -- only the clean overall totals (33/33/79) at the bottom of the table were extractable with confidence. This table itself is document-level front matter, not a per-node record, so it is not flagged NEEDS_REVIEW on any curriculum node, but is recorded here as a genuine source-document data-quality issue.

Teaching and Learning Resources (TLR) in this document are attached at the CONTENT STANDARD level (one bullet-list block printed at the end of each Content Standard's Learning-Indicator block, under the row label 'Teaching and Learning Resources' printed in the left-hand 'Content Standards' column), NOT at the Sub-Strand level as seen in some other subjects (e.g. Biomedical Science). This is the schema's documented subject-specific attachment point ('attach at whichever level it's actually printed') -- teachingLearningResources/teachingLearningResourcesHeaderSeen fields are therefore placed on each contentStandards[] node in this file, not on subStrands[] nodes.

Bullet-glyph note: default pdftotext encoding renders the source bullet character as the mojibake symbol; re-extracted with 'pdftotext -enc UTF-8' which renders it correctly as U+2022 (bullet). All text below uses the corrected bullet character; this is an extraction-tooling fix, not a content correction.

Year One, Strand 1, Sub-Strand 3 (The Earth Atmosphere), Content Standard 1.1.3.CS.1, Learning Indicator 3: the printed code reads '1.1.1.3LI3' (PDF page ~38) instead of the expected '1.1.3.LI.3' pattern used by its sibling indicators (1.1.3.LI.1, 1.1.3.LI.2) in the same block. Preserved verbatim as printed; flagged NEEDS_REVIEW on all three Learning Indicators.

Year One, Strand 1, Sub-Strand 1, Learning Outcome 1.1.1.LO.1: the SEL guidance bullet list as extracted contains 'SMART goal setting' twice (once near the top and once at the end of the same bullet block, PDF pages 25-26) where sibling Learning Outcomes' equivalent lists do not repeat an item. This may be a genuine source duplication or an artifact of column-collision text extraction across the page break; preserved verbatim as extracted, not flagged NEEDS_REVIEW individually (routine layout-wrap ambiguity per the extraction-tooling convention used elsewhere in this pipeline), but noted here for visibility.

Front matter (PDF pages 1-24, printed pages i/1-22): shared SHS boilerplate covering the SHS Curriculum Overview, Philosophy/Vision/Goal of Geography, 21st Century Skills, GESI, SEL's Five Core Competencies, Learning and Teaching Approaches, UDL, the Bloom's/Webb's DoK assessment framework, the Curriculum Development Panel list (PDF page 23), and the Scope-and-Sequence summary table (PDF page 24) -- not re-extracted per-node per the schema's Phase 5 design notes (document-level context, not curriculum-tree content).
